preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The integer N is between 1 and 10^100, exclusive.
The cost to turn on each segment is between 1 and 50, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: exists(factor in factors(N)) min(sum(segment_costs(factor)) for segment_costs in segment_combinations(factors(N)) if all(segment_costs[i] >= 0 for i in range(7)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, find the minimum number of coins needed to display some factor of N on the panel, where factors(N) is the set of all factors of N, and segment_combinations(factors(N)) is the set of all possible combinations of segment costs for each factor.
